gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-batak: Oxanium draws every curve with one unvarying pen, its tall lowercase ending in clear daylight. And Noto Sans Batak counters with a stubby, towering x-height and an e that stays wide open.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali has open letter mouths and capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Noto Sans Bengali keeps a long stretch of text feeling contemporary and easy to move through, never cramped.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Oxanium sketches even its g in a single unchanging line weight, giving the heading a stiff, rod-stock confidence. Its monoline rigor is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads light, with a high mean line and curves left open. Against Oxanium's squeezed-toothpaste monoline, the pair's strongest quality is how the display lettering feels sealed and sturdy while the body breathes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Oxanium has the thickness of neon glass tubing, bright and commanding. Noto Sans Buhid then carries a longer passage with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, so the text keeps a plain sans openness.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-carian: Oxanium runs a monoline stroke from start to finish, bold and distinctive. Noto Sans Carian lets a longer passage unfold with terminals held apart like open scissor blades, tidy and clean in sans-serif fashion.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans Chakma says. Over a longer stretch its lowercase sits packed up toward the caps, while open s and c mouths keep the sans from ever feeling crowded, against Oxanium's thin joins that are no thinner than its stems.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham reads modern and clean, with tall rounded lowercase and c shapes that leave plenty of entry space. Shrink Oxanium too far and its pencil-steady strokes lose their punch.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads as a tall band of letters under short stalks, friendly and professional. And over a longer stretch, its e keeps a wide gap at the terminal, a plain sans ease that Oxanium, with no thick-thin flicker, never competes with.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian stops its curves short instead of closing them. Give its large x-height a modest size, and let Oxanium's skimming, uniform strokes carry the commanding voice above that plain sans text.
